info.title: Partas.ExternalAnnotations.Tool
info.description: Generates ReSharper external annotations for an assembly and ships them inside its NuGet package.

x-inspectra.cliParsedDescription: Generates and ships ReSharper external annotations with a NuGet package

commands.name: generate
commands.description: Generates a ReSharper external annotations file from an assembly

options.name: --strict
options.description: Fail when any member is skipped, rather than warning and continuing [default: False]

options.name: --attribute
options.description: Collect only these attributes, by simple name; the default is every JetBrains.Annotations attribute [default: System.String[]]

commands.name: verify
commands.description: Fails unless every assembly in a .nupkg has an annotations sidecar

options.name: --min-members
options.description: Fail when any assembly's sidecar annotates fewer members than this [default: 0]

commands.name: init
commands.description: Writes the external annotations Directory.Build.targets (commit the result)

options.name: --annotations-tool
options.description: Command that generates annotations during pack, e.g. 'dotnet partas-annotations'
